name: Convixo – Revenue Booster for WooCommerce
author: webtendhq

sections.description:
Convixo adds a set of focused, lightweight conversion features to WooCommerce. Every feature has its own on/off switch, and scripts and styles load only on WooCommerce pages.

Features

  • Upsell & cross-sell grid – a “You May Also Like” section on product pages, using the product’s upsells with related products as a fallback.
  • Frequently Bought Together – checkbox bundle on simple product pages with a live total and one-click add to cart.
  • Cart page cross-sells – WooCommerce cross-sell products shown on the cart page.
  • Urgency countdown timer – a countdown to a date you set. The timer is global (the same end date for every product).
  • Free shipping progress bar – cart and checkout progress toward free shipping. Optionally reads the threshold from your WooCommerce Free Shipping method; bar color is configurable.
  • Recently viewed products – tracks viewed products in a browser cookie, auto-displays on product pages, shortcode [convixo_recently_viewed], and a “Clear history” link for shoppers.
  • Stock alerts – a low-stock notice (“Only X left”) based on real WooCommerce stock levels.
  • Back-in-stock notifications (off by default) – out-of-stock products show an email form; each shopper is emailed once when the product returns, then the address is deleted.
  • Minimum order amount – cart notice, progress bar and checkout validation.
  • Sticky Add to Cart bar – appears when the main button scrolls out of view; shows the product image, name, rating and price.
  • Quantity +/- buttons – styled controls that respect min, max and step, with optional automatic cart update.
  • Add to Cart toast – a small corner notification with a View Cart link.

Notes

  • Requires WooCommerce.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Fully translatable (text domain convixo-for-woocommerce).

Shortcode

[convixo_recently_viewed] – display the visitor's recently viewed products anywhere.

Privacy

  • Recently viewed: product IDs are stored in a browser cookie named convixo_rv for up to 30 days. No personal data is stored on the server.
  • Back-in-stock notifications (only if you enable them): the email address a shopper enters is stored in the site’s database until the one-off notification has been sent, then it is deleted. Remaining addresses are removed when the plugin is uninstalled. Addresses are used only to send that notification and are not shared with any third party. Consider mentioning this in your privacy policy.
  • The plugin does not contact any external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the convixo-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open Convixo in the admin menu and switch on the features you want.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Is the countdown timer per product?

No. The timer is global: it counts down to the single end date you set in the settings.

Can I disable individual features?

Yes. Each feature can be switched on or off from the Convixo settings screen.

Does the quantity +/- control change my cart?

It changes the quantity field and triggers WooCommerce’s normal cart update. With “Auto-update cart” enabled, the cart refreshes shortly after the quantity changes.

Does the Sticky Add to Cart bar work with variable products?

Yes. For variable products the bar scrolls the shopper back to the variation selector.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, compatibility is declared with WooCommerce.
